column1: *** "firmo Don RAMON LERENA Alcalde de la ..." ***, with "En dicho dia ... Yo Don RAMON LERENA Alcalde de la ..." - four separate matches on one file
column2: *** Garcia, Clemente: Buenos Aires City. PROBATE ESTATE CASE FILES, 1800 ***
column3: *** A RAMON LERENA ACTING AS AN ALCALDE IN BUENOS AIRES IN 1800 *** - signing, so holding office. This register's *** RAMON LERENA of Rosario-Colla *** is recorded as flourishing c.1800-1820 and sits at the apex of the kinship diagram the Cura Vicario of Trinidad drew in 1858. *** THE DATE FITS AND THE PLACE DOES NOT: Buenos Aires is across the river from Colla. *** This is a CANDIDATE and emphatically not a match; the archive has been burned by exactly this kind of resemblance before. *** THE FILE WAS OPENED THE SAME DAY. *** He is *** "ALCALDE DE LA SANTA HERMANDAD DEL PARTIDO DEL ROSARIO", signing on 6 NOVEMBER 1800 *** in the estate of DON CLEMENTE GARCIA, notifying the widow DONA CELESTINA GONZALEZ, and certifying *** "a falta de Escribano Publico ni Real, por no haberlo en esta Jurisdiccion" ***. *** HE SIGNS HIS OWN NAME TWICE *** - where Sancho Llerena, nine years earlier, could not. *** THE PLACE IS STILL NOT PROVED: *** the file mentions a "vecindad del partido ORIENTAL", which points at the Banda Oriental and so at this row's Rosario, but there is a Partido del Rosario on the Argentine side too and the OCR around that word is broken. *** NOT MERGED. 249 images in the item; one frame read. ***

column1: *** "ante mi VICENTE LERENA DIAZ de Registro ..." ***, four times, in the formula a civil registrar uses to close an entry
column2: *** Libro de defunciones: Pueblo Brugo, Parana, ENTRE RIOS. Death Records, 1938 ***
column3: *** THE COMPOUND IS THE POINT: LERENA DIAZ. *** This register holds *** ARTURO LERENA GARCIA married to AMALIA DIAZ *** - the Spanish journalist of the Chile file - and their children would be surnamed exactly this. *** It also holds ANTONIO LERENA DIAZ, who married Clara Henriette Knof in 1924. *** So a Lerena Diaz keeping the civil register of a village in Entre Rios in 1938 is plausibly that household's next generation. *** NOT ESTABLISHED. *** And it bears directly on work-list row 159, which asks for Entre Rios to be mapped.

column1: *** "de D. ELOY LERENA natural de ESPANA de ..." *** and *** "y de Dona FELISA LERENA natural de Espana ..." ***, with *** "D. GREGORIO LERENA y Dona ROSA DEFENARI" *** and "Daniel Gregorio Lerena Figueroa"
column2: *** San Jose de Flores, Comuna 7, Buenos Aires City. BAPTISM RECORDS 1912 *** (the snippet's years span 1909-1912)
column3: *** SPANISH-BORN LERENAS IN A BUENOS AIRES PARISH, NAMED AS SUCH ON THE ACT. *** This register already holds *** FELISA LERENA (arr. 1911) ***, *** FELISA LERENA (arr. 1923) ***, *** GREGORIO LERENA (arr. 1911) *** and *** GREGORIO LERENA (arr. 1924) *** - every one of them from CEMLA passenger lists and *** none of them with a single record on Argentine soil ***. Here are a Felisa and a Gregorio in a parish register, with Spain stated. *** THIS IS THE FIRST CHANCE TO TURN AN ARRIVAL INTO A LIFE ***, and it is also the parish of the 1918 Villademoros baptism this archive already holds. *** THIS ONE HAS SINCE BEEN OPENED - 11 October 2026, the same day. *** Act No. 461: JUANA, born 25 June 1912, baptised 10 November 1912, hija legitima of ELOY LERENA, 26, and FELISA LERENA, 21, both naturales de Espana, with GREGORIO LERENA and ROSA DEFENARI as godparents. *** BOTH PARENTS ARE LERENAS - a fifth such couple here, and the first that is Spanish and urban. *** Eloy, Juana and Rosa Defenari are now in the register. *** THE CEMLA ARRIVALS WERE NOT MERGED INTO IT *** - the ages are two years out and the 1911 pair travelled together while here Gregorio is only a godfather.
